data.assumption: “Sales value” means the sum of successful non-test payment attempt amounts in INR for Tamil Nadu showrooms over the inclusive 30-day business-date window from 2026-08-12 through 2026-09-10.
data.sql:
SELECT s.name AS showroom_name, SUM(pa.amount_minor) AS value
FROM payment_attempts pa
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = s.region_id
WHERE pa.is_test = false
  AND o.is_test = false
  AND pa.status = 'succeeded'
  AND pa.currency = 'INR'
  AND r.name = 'Tamil Nadu'
  AND pa.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-12' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
GROUP BY s.showroom_id, s.name
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 5
